senses.gloss:
m. (-रुः)
1 A sort of deer.
2 A Daitya flayed by ŚIVA.
E.
रु to weep, कु aff.

mfn. (-त्सुः-त्सुः-त्सु).
1 Wishing to oppose or obstruct.
2 Wishing to bind or tie up, (as the hair.)
E.
रुध to oppose, desid. v., उ aff.

mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु)
Wishing or purposing to wail or weep, ready to cry.
E.
रुद to weep, desid. v., उ aff.
